name: P/A ~Potential Ability~
source:
This is a story set in a next future.
About the five per cent of the mankind is known to be endowed with a certain ability.
This ability is called "P/A" or "Potential Ability", that means that it is latent.

All around the world academies that had the purpose to conduct toward the best direction the youth that had got this kind of ability had been founded, the students that had got various kind of P/A, abilities that will bring them to become politicians, industrialists and religionists, the future leaders of the world, or abilities in fields as arts, public entertainment and sports, are enrolled in these academies.

According to the researches, basically one person can have got only a P/A, but there are even "Dual Ability master (D/A)" and "Multi Ability master (M/A)", extraordinarily rare cases in which the persons have got multiple abilities.

The Jougasaki Gakuen is one of the academies where the youth that had got the P/A goes to.
Among the students going there, the ones having got physically effective powers are few, most of them have got abilities that provoke effective interior alterations of the mental state.

The size of the worth of a P/A ability is proportional to the spirit's strenght.
Nevertheless, even when they can't use well the spirit, in other words when the spirit is not again mature, once in a while there are P/A owners whose ability's worth becomes strangely high.
They, in the Jougasaki Gakuen, are given the label of drop-outs and are isolated in "special classrooms".

Kouichi Nomaguchi, the main character, who aims to become a teacher is sent to the Jougasaki Gakuen to make his teaching practice.
But he isn't a P/A owner, is just a normal person who hasn't got abilities.
Moreover Kouichi isn't immune to the women, he is a timid man that gets ruffled only speaking to members of the opposite sex.
But the Jougasaki Gakuen was a only girls' school, moreover it was a unique academy where all the teachers and the staff members were women.
He didn't know the reason for he, a normal person and a male, had been called by that academy, but as, except the Jougasaki Gakuen, there hadn't been other academies who had accepted him as trainee, holding his anxiety he decides to go there.

LOVE & PEACE
Please, give divine protection to the puzzled lamb ...

(Translation of [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=802105&gc=gc]Getchu.com[/url] page)
translation:
这是一个发生在近未来的故事。
据悉，人类中约有5%的人天生拥有某种能力。
这种能力被称为“P/A”，即“潜在能力”（Potential Ability），意味着它处于潜伏状态。

世界各地陆续建立起学院，旨在引导拥有这种能力的年轻人走向最适合自己的道路。拥有各种P/A能力的学生都在这些学院就读：有些能力能让人成为政治家、实业家和宗教家等未来世界的领导者，也有些能力属于艺术、大众娱乐和体育领域。

根据研究，一个人通常只能拥有一种P/A，但也存在极其罕见的多重能力者，例如“双重能力大师（D/A）”和“多重能力大师（M/A）”。

城崎学园是拥有P/A的年轻人就读的学院之一。
在那里就读的学生中，拥有直接作用于身体的能力者很少，大多数人的能力会有效改变精神状态。

P/A能力的价值大小与精神力强度成正比。
然而，即使无法很好地运用精神力，换言之精神尚未成熟，偶尔也会有P/A持有者的能力价值异常之高。
在城崎学园，他们被贴上“落伍者”的标签，隔离在“特别教室”里。

主人公野口浩一立志成为教师，被派往城崎学园进行教学实习。
但他并不是P/A持有者，只是一个没有任何能力的普通人。
而且浩一对女性毫无抵抗力，是个仅仅与异性说话就会手足无措的胆小男人。
偏偏城崎学园是一所女子学校，还是一所教师和教职员工全都是女性的特殊学院。
他不知道那所学院为何会召来一个普通男性，但除了城崎学园，也没有其他学院愿意接收他作为实习生，于是他怀着不安决定前往那里。

LOVE & PEACE
请为迷惘的羔羊赐予神的庇佑……

（译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=802105&gc=gc]Getchu.com[/url]页面）
